questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Everything is bright and beautiful, ______?
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of question tag is brought under consideration. Since, noun 'everything' does not denote a person. So, pronoun **it **should be used. Hence, **option 2 **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

They are terribly busy with ______ work.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Since, subject pronoun 'they' is given, thus options 1 & 4 are clearly eliminated. Now, blank is followed by noun 'work'. This shows that possessive pronoun **their **should be used. Because object pronoun 'them' and noun 'work' cannot come together. Hence, **option 2 **is the appropriate answer.

**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Rest on one's laurels
questions.solution:

The meaning of given idiom is to be so satisfied with what one has already done or achieved that one makes no further effort. This means to retire from one's active life. Hence, **option 1 **is the appropriate answer.

For example :- With TV sports coverage becoming increasingly competitive, the BBC should beware of resting on its laurels.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

The main (causes of this failure is) inadequate ability growth and character development.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

If we use 'causes' then verb 'are' should come. If we use 'cause' then verb 'is' should come. Likewise, **option 3 **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**Directions: Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

If they (did not know their ability) and they do not know which sports they want to do, they will not learn to play any sports and will not succeed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'do not know their ability'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

The given bracketed part should be replaced with **'do not know their ability'**

 
• The two verb phrases i.e. 'do not know which' and 'did not know their ability' are joined with the conjunction 'and' hence we need to keep these phrases in the same degrees i.e. present tense. Hence, we need to use 'do not know their ability'
 
• Also, this sentence is the conditional sentence the main clause is in the future tense hence, we need to use 'the present tense' in the subordinate clause.

**So the correct sentence is-** *If they** do not know their ability** and they do not know which sports they want to do, they will not learn to play any sports and will not succeed.*

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

His vision

P: hardly related to

Q: and goals were

R: the reality around him
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Clearly, sequence PQ is grammatically incorrect because preposition is either followed by noun, pronoun or verb. Hence, options 3 & 4 are eliminated. And, a sentence does not end with transitive word(that needs object). Hence, option 1 is incorrect. So, **option 2 i.e. QPR **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

Pollution needs

P: otherwise our future generations

Q: to be tackled seriously

R: would suffer a lot
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Since, starter ends with verb, thus it will not continue with modal verb 'would'. Hence, option 3 is incorrect. In option 1, sequence RQ is incorrect. And, option 2 does not make a meaningful sentence. Hence, **option 4 i.e. QPR **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question: Let us look at the positive and negative effects of peer pressure.television and other ______ of life
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

The given passage is based upon how thoughts, behavior, taste, music etc of other people have a major impact on a person. This influence is called as peer pressure which either have positive impact or negative. This depends on the thoughtful analysis by the people themselves. Since, option 2 is clearly out of context. Now, 'other' is an adjective which takes positive noun if singular word 'an' or 'one' is not given before it. Hence, option 3 is incorrect. 'Thoughts' is already mentioned which means word 'ideas' will make a repetition. Hence, option 4 is incorrect. So, **option 1 i.e. walks **is the suitable answer.

questions.question: a ______ impact on the living
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

As, article 'a' is given, so it should be followed by an adjective because noun(impact) is already given. Thus, verb 'follow' is incorrect. 

Now, 'impact' is always strong. Hence, we cannot use 'slow' or 'mere'(used to emphasize how small or insignificant someone or something is). Thus, **option 2 i.e. deep **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question: peers often ______ us to change
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Clearly, option 4 is eliminated because 'changing ways' is a plural noun, hence plural verb(**without s/es) **should come. Since, the whole passage is based upon peer pressure. Hence, it is given that changing ways of life of our peers(a person of the same age, status, or ability as another specified person) **force **us to change our ways of living. Thus, **option 3 i.e. force **is an appropriate answer.

questions.question: both, positively and ______.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

It is clearly that adverb 'positively' will be followed by 'negatively' to give a synchronization. Hence, **option 4 i.e. negatively **is the correct answer.

Also, peer pressure have both positive and negative impact upon us.

questions.question: Following your peers ______ leaves a
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, peer pressure arises when we follow our peers blindly. Thus, **option 1 i.e. blindly **is the appropriate answer.

questions.solution:

1st number + 2ⁿd number + 3rd number + **1** = 4th number

Row 1 = 10 + 4 + 15 + **1** = 30

questions.question: What is the value of 8(1)/(7) + 5(3)/(7) + 4(2)/(7) + 3(1)/(7)?

**Step-2: **Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

**Step-3:** Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

**Step-4: **Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

 Rightarrow {{ }}8(1)/(7) + 5(3)/(7) + 4(2)/(7) + 3(1)/(7) = ?

questions.question: A number when divided by 18 leaves remainder 15. What is the remainder when the same number is divided by 6?
questions.solution:
Let the number be n.

Given,

A number when divided by 18 leaves remainder 15-

Let the quotient be a.

⇒ n = 18a + 15

⇒ n = 6(3a) + 15

⇒ n = (6 × 3)a + 6 + 9

⇒ n = 6(3a + 1) + 9

⇒ n = 6(3a + 1) + 6 + 3

⇒ n = 6[(3a + 1) + 1] + 3

⇒ n = 6(3a + 2) + 3

∴Then the reminder is 3 when same number is divisible by 6.

questions.question: P is twice as good as Q and together they ﬁnish a piece of work in 36 days. The number of days taken by P alone to ﬁnish the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Q's efficiency be 1 unit/day. Since P is twice as efficient, P's efficiency = 2 units/day.

Combined efficiency of P and Q = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

Total Work = Combined efficiency × Number of days together = 3 × 36 = 108 units.

Time taken by P alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of P = 108 ÷ 2 = 54 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ P is twice as efficient as Q.

⇒ P and Q together finish the piece of work in 36 days.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P + Q

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of Q = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Since P is twice as good as Q, efficiency of P = 2 units/day.

⇒ Total efficiency of P and Q working together = 2 + 1 = 3 units/day.

⇒ Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Time taken = 3 × 36 = 108 units.

⇒ Time taken by P alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of P.

⇒ Time taken by P alone = 108 ÷ 2 = 54 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency & Time Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If a person is twice as efficient as another, they will take half the time to finish the same piece of work.

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the total work done by each person. If people work for the exact same number of days, wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their daily efficiencies.

Pipes & Cisterns

This topic works on the exact identical mathematical concept as Time & Work. The only difference applies to emptying or leakage pipes, where the efficiency is considered strictly negative.

questions.question: If the diagonal of a square is 10 cm, then what is the area (in cm²) of the square?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diagonal of a square is 10 cm.

**Formula used:**

Area of square = (side)²

The perimeter of the square = 4 × side

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501173f78d456316152593495c96a6737f546a159bf92d9f688a2bd4bc50711b.png] 

The diagonal of a square is 10 cm.

The diagonal of a square = √2 × side of a square

Side of a square = 10 / √2 cm.

Area of a square = side²

Area of a square = (10/√2)²

Area of a square = 100/2 = 50

**∴ Area of a square is 50cm².**

= 150

Profit percentage of an article =

= [(S.P - C.P) / C.P] × 100

= [(135 - 100)/100] × 100

= 35%

∴ Profit percentage of an article is 35%.

⇒ a = 42

∴ The two numbers are 42 and 56 respectively.

questions.question: A number is ﬁrst decreased by 30% and then increased by 30%. If the number so obtained is 72 less than the original number, then what is the value of the original number?

A number is ﬁrst decreased by 30% -

= n - 3n/10

= 7n/10

The new number = 7n/10

And then increased by 30% -

= 7n/10 + (7n/10) × 30/100

= 7n/10 + 21n/100

= 91n/100

The number becomes = 91n/100

Given,

⇒ n - 91n/100 = 72

⇒ 9n/100 = 72

⇒ 9n = 7200

⇒ n = 800

**∴ The value of original number is 800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png]

Total percentage change = [a + b + ab/100]%

Percentage change = –30 + 30 – (30 × 30)/100 = –9

The number will decrease by 9%

9% of the original number = 72

⇒ (9/100) × Original Number = 72

⇒ Original Number = 72 × 100/9 = 800

**∴ The value of the original number is 800**

questions.question: Speeds of a boat along the current and against the current are 16 km/hr and 12 km/hr respectively. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the current?
questions.solution:
**Given,**

Speed downstream = 16km/hr

Speed upstream = 12km/hr

**Formula used:**

Speed of the current = ½ × (speed downstream - speed upstream)

**Calculation:**

Speed of the current = ½ × (16 - 12) = 4/2 = 2

**∴ Speed of the current is 2km/hr.**

questions.question: In order to make a bill into a law it is required to pass through _____.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• The introduction or proposal of a draft in **both the houses of the Parliament** is the primary step in law making.
 
• This draft is called a bill and once it has been passed by both the Houses, it is then sent to the President for approval.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__**There are 4 types of Bills which can be introduced in the Parliament**__

 
• Ordinary Bills - Related to any matter apart from financial subjects.
 
• Money Bills - Related to financial matters like taxation.
 
• Financial Bills - Related to financial matters other than those things included in Money bills
 
• Constitution amendment bills - Related to the amendment of the Constitution.

__**There are five stages in the enactment of an ordinary bill **__

 
• First reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Second reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Third reading ( in the House in which it is introduced)
 
• Bill in the second House ( first reading, second reading, third reading )
 
• Assent of the President.

questions.question: Which is the second largest continent of the world after Asia?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Asia__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

Africa:

__
 
• The **second-largest continent**, Africa is renowned for its **vibrant wildlife,** rich cultural heritage, and stunning natural beauty.
 
• From the vast savannas of the Serengeti to the towering peaks of the **Atlas Mountains**, Africa is a land of endless discovery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Earth has seven continents, each with its own unique characteristics and fascinating details. Here's a glimpse into each of them:

**Asia**:

 
• With a surface area of approximately 44 million km2 Asia is the largest continent on Earth.
 
• It is primarily located in the Northern and Eastern hemispheres of the Earth.
 
• It is the largest and most populous continent, Asia is home to diverse cultures, landscapes, and historical significance.
 
• From the towering Himalayas to the sprawling Gobi Desert, Asia offers a kaleidoscope of experiences.

North America:

 
• This continent is known for its diverse landscapes, ranging from the towering mountains of Alaska to the sun-drenched beaches of California.
 
• North America is also a melting pot of cultures and ethnicities, making it a vibrant and dynamic region.

South America:

 
• Home to the Amazon rainforest, the Andes Mountains, and the vibrant cultures of Brazil and Argentina, South America is a continent teeming with life and natural beauty.
 
• From the ancient ruins of Machu Picchu to the breathtaking Iguazu Falls, South America offers endless opportunities for exploration.

Antarctica:

 
• The frozen continent of Antarctica is a land of mystery and scientific exploration.
 
• Covered in a thick ice sheet, Antarctica is home to diverse penguin colonies, seals, and whales.
 
• It's also a crucial region for understanding climate change and the Earth's ecosystem.

Europe:

 
• The continent of Europe is steeped in history and culture.
 
• From the ancient ruins of Rome to the modern metropolises of London and Paris, Europe offers a rich tapestry of experiences.
 
• The continent is also known for its stunning natural beauty, with diverse landscapes ranging from the Alps to the Mediterranean Sea.

Australia:

 
• The smallest continent by landmass, Australia is an island nation renowned for its unique wildlife, vast outback, and stunning beaches.
 
• From the iconic Sydney Opera House to the Great Barrier Reef, Australia offers a unique blend of natural beauty and modern vibrancy.

questions.question: Which part of the flower is colorful and attracts insects?
questions.solution:
• Petals are colorful leaf like structures of the plant that surround the male and female reproductive organs of the plant.
 
• They are colorful and therefore attract bees and humming birds which helps in pollination.

questions.question: The balance of CO₂ and O₂ in atmosphere is due to ______.
questions.solution:
• Photosynthesis is the process by which plants take up carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and convert it into carbohydrates releasing oxygen in the process.
 
• This helps to maintain carbon dioxide and oxygen levels in the atmosphere.

questions.question: Excretion means ______.

options.text: Removal of substances present in excess
Formation of those substances that have some role in the body
Removal of such substances that have never been part of the body

questions.solution:

• The removal of these substances by the body is called excretion.

questions.question: Metallurgy is the process of ______.

options.text: Adding metal to the Ore in blast furnace

questions.question: Metals have __________.

options.text: High melting and low boiling point
Low melting and high boiling point

questions.solution:
• Metals are made up of tightly packed molecules which have strong forces of attraction.
 
• To overcome these strong forces, metals have high melting and boiling point.

questions.question: Which among the following considered to be the ﬁnancial turn around and rival package for electricity distribution companies of India?

questions.question: The 250 km Tamu-Kalewa-Kalemyo highway is a gift to Myanmar is built by ______.
questions.solution:
• The 250 km Tamu-Kalewa-Kalemyo highway is a part of the ‘Trilateral Highway project’ that aims at connecting India, Myanmar and Thailand.
